description: Tell us whether a call worked; on a failure, get up to three currently verified alternatives and eligible published workflows (no retry is executed). Retain the selected protocol and reject known shared failure domains. Use after a call to record the outcome and, on failure, get verified alternatives. Example arguments: {"resource_id": 133020, "ok": false, "error_type": "timeout"} Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.

error.description: Optional error message or reason on failure

error_type.description: Optional structured failure category. This report never authorizes a retry.

execution_ref.description: X-Execution-Reference of your run through our gateway (last 24 hours). Only such a report counts toward ranking; others are recorded.

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded (true) or failed (false)

protocol.description: Optional explicit recovery scope; otherwise retain the prior selection.

resource_id.description: The resource_id of the agent/tool that was executed

task.description: The task query (optional; defaults to your last searched task)

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: report

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.

title: Report a call outcome
